parameters.name: APIEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable MMS API exposure on FAP

parameters.name: QueueEnable
parameters.description: Enable or disable Request queueing for the API

parameters.name: Queueing
parameters.description: Determines how FAP handles simultaneous requests from different Applications to MMS API.

parameters.name: MaxAPIUsersNumber
parameters.description: Determines the Max Number of different Applications that can send Requests to MMS API.

parameters.name: MinSendMMSTimeInterval
parameters.description: Determines the Minimum Time Interval in {{units}} between two consecutive Send MMS Requests by the same Application.

parameters.name: EnableQueryMMSDeliveryStatus
parameters.description: Enable or disable "QuerySMSDeliveryStatus" Operation on MMS API. When disabled, QuerySMSDeliveryStatus Requests to MMS API are ignored.

parameters.name: EnableSubscribeToNotificationsOfMessageSentToApplication
parameters.description: Enable or disable "SubscribeTo NotificationsOfMessageSentToApplication" Operation on MMS API. When disabled, SubscribeTo NotificationsOfMessageSentToApplication Requests to MMS API are ignored.

object.description: This object contains parameters related to the MMS API.
